Texas Utility & Grid Integration

Our surveyors are trained on the exact meter socket, disconnect, and labeling standards required across Texas electric territories.

Oncor Electric Delivery

Territory: DFW, North & Central Texas
Grid Structure: Largest ERCOT TDU

Territory: Greater Houston & Gulf Coast
Grid Structure: Major Metro TDU

AEP Texas (North & Central)

Territory: South Texas, Corpus Christi, West Texas
Grid Structure: Statewide TDU

Territory: Gulf Coast, North Texas, West Texas
Grid Structure: Regional TDU

CPS Energy

Territory: San Antonio & Bexar County
Grid Structure: Municipal Electric Utility

Austin Energy

Grid Structure: Municipal Electric Utility

Territory: El Paso & Far West Texas
Grid Structure: Investor-Owned Utility

CoServ Electric

Territory: North Texas (Denton, Collin)
Grid Structure: Electric Cooperative
